text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
My water bottle, perfectly frozen at an
angle! An icy-cool patch for my
forehead! Salty candies to
keep me
hydrated!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Got my checklist, got my coin pouch...
Can't
forget my participant badge
either! Everything
else looks... perfect!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So long as my new issues shipped in no
problem,
I'm all good to go! ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oof! I don't wanna miss the new issue my
neighbor
put out either. We're into the
same genre, after
all...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Shgaafklf?! Th-this is... so amazing! The
cover
alone is a flooded spectacle of
maximum divinity!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Fasdfjiwi! Take my money! Please, let me
buy this!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hm?! This seller's art seems very
familiar.

Particularly the way they draw the ears...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ack?! No, y-you can't be serious!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's Umakko Pyonkichi, the artist who did work on that crazy popular cartoon back in the day, UMA ★ Dreamworld Berserker !

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whooooa! They've stayed alive long
enough to grace us with their presence
today! I've always
wanted to see their
own original work!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff... S-summer this year is really heating up! I love these conventions!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I should offer something as a gift...
Since
we're right in the middle of
summer, maybe...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Preferably something that doesn't spoil.
Oh, and
another essential—something
that helps you keep
cool.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Staying hydrated and retaining sodium
are both important, but drinking too
much water can
potentially be
dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes. Besides, all the artists surely
have
prepared their own beverages
ahead of time!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So, a letter would probably be the best
idea! I
was so happy when a fan wrote
one for me!
Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see. It would appear her increased
verbosity
stems from this summer
activity. Hmm, very
interesting!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Digital, please tell me more
about this
summer event!
